name: Evanston FMC Spring 2026
information: This competition only holds the Fewest Moves event. As such, it is not recommended for first time competitors to attend. If you are looking for a more traditional competition that holds events like 3x3, 2x2, or Pyraminx, please check out other competitions in Illinois. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa2RzIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1453c8aaf7bdb7b72ecc9b7a8750daf3efabd9d4/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png)
